children.text: ED2 is considered the most beginner friendly Elite Dungeon. The requirements to feasibly solo it both in terms of gear and skill are generally considered low. However, it still has considerable amount of challenging components which can result in fast KOs if the player is not careful.

Mob clearing in ED2 is arguably the most tricky to do properly amongst the trilogy. There are various portions of the dungeon where you can be subjected to many sources of damage. Thus, using powerful abilities to clear and moving fast from place to place will benefit you greatly.
⬥ Laboratory Slimes hitting you will spawn clone slimes (signified by 'Bloop').

to avoid getting overwhelmed in the first room.
    • Clear the light-coloured slimes to open barriers, the darker-coloured clones being killed will not progress the dungeon.
⬥ All gemstone dragons standing not in melee distance can fire a gemstone spike special attack, dealing high magic damage and secondary effect depending on the type of dragon.

• Dragonstone dragon - Halves your antifire/super antifire duration.
    • Onyx dragon - Heals the dragon for 4000 HP.
    • Hydrix dragon - Instantly drains all adrenaline and applies a debuff that halves adrenaline for about 15 seconds.
    • Be careful of this especially when fighting multiple dragons.
    • Avoid these specs by stepping 2 tiles away from your original location before the spikes land.
​
⬥ Sometime after hitting below 36,000 HP, Celestial Dragons will start healing rapidly for 2400 HP each tick following a message. It will then repeat this every 6 auto attacks.

• Stun or bind the dragon to stop the healing.
